_about: Registry of every data source: its role, where it is pulled from, which winters it covers, when it is known (as-of), its clock, cost, redistribution, and what it feeds. scripts/check_architecture.py fails if a raw folder or a derived file is not accounted for here. Roles: OUTCOME = what happened (labels); FEATURE = model input with a stated as-of; CALENDAR = dates that define when things can happen; FORECAST = a feature known before the call; COMMENTARY = human narrative kept for SPOT CHECKS when a number or parse is in doubt, never fitted or scored; CHECK = independent measurement used only to validate; REFERENCE = identity and history of things (lifts, stations, names). Status: VERIFIED = run and checked on the date given.
layers: raw (data/raw, never edited, hashed in docs/RAW_INVENTORY.md)
parsed or extracted (data/derived, stamped with parser or reader version)
lift-day table (data/derived/lift_days.csv, one row per lift per day, every column in rules/features.json)
commentary index (data/derived/blog_posts.csv, blog_text.jsonl; read with scripts/commentary.py)

sources.what: Ops account posts: lift holds, delays, reopenings, schedules, closures (originals only)
sources.pull: scripts/x_pull.py (2018-19 on), scripts/x_pull.py also used for 2015-16 to 2017-18
sources.as_of: post time (UTC in the file; events are stamped America/Los_Angeles)
sources.status: VERIFIED 2026-11-07; 2015-16 to 2017-18 pulled 2026-11-08, not parsed, frozen samples drawn first
sources.caveat: a hold nobody posted is invisible; Squaw-era wording (2015-2021) needs parser work on training posts only

sources.what: Resort weather stations (Western Weather Group report builder), hourly
sources.as_of: morning window 05:00-09:00 or full-day window 06:00-16:00 (see rules/features.json)
sources.clock: local time, unlabelled by the vendor; supported by two checks (DATA_SOURCES section 13 and the Truckee airport test)
feeds: data/derived/lift_days.csv (2016-17 and 2017-18 through the common feature set, planned)
sources.caveat: fields grow from 11 to 36 over the years; only Siberia, Belmont and Roundhouse Btm cover all ten winters; hourly day-max gust equals the 15-minute one at Siberia (r 0.993)
15-minute data begins Feb 2018; Funitel Top is partly estimated (fnt_src)

sources.what: SNOTEL 784 Palisades Tahoe (8,010 ft): snow water, depth, precipitation, temperature, wind
sources.caveat: depth sensor spikes; as a stand-in for Siberia day-max gust R2 0.67

sources.what: Sierra Avalanche Center forecasts (danger rating per day)
sources.caveat: one zone for the region; coverage thin before 2020

sources.what: NWS Reno watches, warnings and advisories for the Greater Lake Tahoe zone (IEM VTEC archive)
ONI and RONI El Nino indices
Lift list fetched from the resort's pages (upper vs lower mountain definition)
Palisades Tahoe operations blog (293 posts, 2015-12 to 2026-10): season dates, staged lift openings, closures with causes, lift construction, stated operating rules
sources.clock: site date is Pacific local (America/Los_Angeles, checked against date_gmt, scripts/check_architecture.py)
sources.redistribution: resort's own copy: keep raw private, quote at most 25 words with the link
sources.caveat: announced plans are not proof they happened; archive text was edited after the 2021 rename (see rules/lift_history.json names). Blog dates are the source of truth for season edges (decision 62); tweet rosters settle the actual last operating day

sources.what: Daily forecast posts by the OpenSnow forecaster (849 posts, 2020-03 on)
sources.as_of: post time (804 of 849 posted by 09:00 local); usable as a morning input only when posted by 09:00
sources.caveat: figures read from text by a regex (reader regex-v1); rank correlation 0.72 with Siberia day max gust over 335 days

sources.what: Blog categories general, stories, experiences, athletes, legends (event and storm write-ups, lift history essays)
sources.caveat: reference only; some 2017 posts quote NOAA sensor readings and embed screenshots

sources.what: Tahoe Daily Snow forecaster account (@TahoeWeather): storm forecasts, resort snowfall reports, occasional wind and lift remarks
sources.caveat: 74 posts give a wind figure, 43 usable days (no wind numbers before 2017-18); not a feature

sources.what: NWS Reno Public Information Statements: snowfall and peak-gust reports by location
sources.caveat: 284 Palisades or Alpine snowfall lines and 168 gust lines, 2017-18 on; one exact tie to our Siberia feed (146 mph, 2018-03-01)

sources.what: NWS Reno Area Forecast Discussions (forecaster narrative, 515-759 per winter)
sources.caveat: a pre-9am issuance exists on every day of every winter (2,673). Regex ridge figure: rank 0.43 with Siberia, not usable. Blind model-read pilot (132 days, 2026-11-08): rank 0.84 on 28 days with a figure; days with no ridge wind in the text were 20% windy, calm calls 6%, figure days 68%. Promising but small; stays COMMENTARY until a full read is tested leave-one-winter-out

sources.what: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo: hourly gust, speed, temperature; snowfall, precipitation, surface pressure
feeds: planned: common feature set and 2015-16 wind estimate
sources.caveat: modelled, about 25 km; gust R2 0.67 against Siberia, snowfall r 0.87 against base depth gain; always flagged as an estimate

sources.what: Truckee-Tahoe airport observations with the time zone stated
sources.caveat: valley site; wind correlation with Siberia 0.62, so not a crest-wind source
samples only, not a record; judged low value for lift level

not_used: NWS Reno remotedata pages linked by the blog (403)
